# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Hearthwing Havoc` as a single-file browser game using vanilla JavaScript Canvas and inline CSS. Preserve the original game truth: a radius-3 axial hex-board duel with six pieces per side, pointer selection, highlighted legal destinations, no allied three-in-a-row moves, occupied-cell blocking, center ray movement, surrounded-by-three enemy removal, alternating player/AI turns, piece-count HUD, and win/loss when a side reaches two pieces. Rebuild the presentation as a deterministic cozy-chaotic dragon-rider sky-roost: orange Hearthwing rider dragons, purple wild wyverns, cloud perches, pastel sky cottages, spark motes, fantasy HUD vocabulary, and mobile-readable start/end overlays. Use only approved catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIFs when media is integrated.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: turn-based abstract hex-board tactics game with a simple AI opponent.
- objective: move allied pieces on a radius-3 hex grid so enemy pieces become adjacent to three opposing pieces and are removed; win when the opponent has two or fewer pieces.
- input model: pointer/touch/click selects one player piece, then pointer/touch/click on a highlighted legal hex moves it; UI buttons start and restart.
- core loop: start board with six pieces per side, player selects and moves a legal piece, surrounded pieces are removed, counts update, AI evaluates and moves, repeat until one side reaches two pieces.
- fail/friction state: illegal destinations are rejected, no allied three-in-a-row move is allowed, player loses if reduced to two pieces.

## Protected mechanics
- Radius-3 axial hex board, initial six-versus-six placement, one selected player piece at a time, adjacent step movement except center pieces can move along rays, occupied hex blocking, no three allied pieces in a line after a move, three-enemy adjacency removal, alternating player/AI turns, animated interpolation, piece-count HUD, win/loss thresholds at two pieces, and start/restart flow.

## Remixed target
Hearthwing Havoc reframes the same tactical loop as a cozy but chaotic dragon-rider sky-roost duel. Player pieces become warm Hearthwing rider dragons, AI pieces become purple wild wyverns, hex sockets become cloud perches, the three-in-a-row prohibition becomes avoiding a sleepy dragon nap-line, captures become chaotic cornering/scattering, and the board lives in a deterministic pastel sky full of cloud cottages and sparkle motes.

identity.title: Hearthwing Havoc
identity.prompt: Create a deterministic creative remix in a cozy game style, centered on a dragon rider, but make it chaotic. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.
identity.identity: A cozy-chaotic dragon-rider sky-roost tactics game built on the preserved hex-board surround loop.
identity.player_role: A Hearthwing rider guiding friendly dragons between cloud perches to scatter wild wyverns.
identity.core_loop: Select a rider dragon, move to a legal cloud perch, avoid a three-dragon nap-line, resolve surrounded pieces, then survive the wyvern response.
